verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found 404s at all common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on workable.readme.io. The llms.txt index, markdown doc pages and the MCP server are machine-readable documentation or other agent capabilities, not a downloadable API specification, so they earn no credit here.
